args.title: Cold-chain articles — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain and its companion piece (https://insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion):

• In 2026 cold-chain logistics, temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
• Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from reduced spoilage.
• The companion piece reports that pilots cut claims by a quarter (25%).
